name: CyberLink Technologies
summary: Perth dialup + satellite broadband ISP (since 1998; CyberLink Ultra via ihug); defunct (CYBER NETWORKS PTY LTD (trading as Cyberlink Technologies), ACN 109 342 074).

events.details: Defunct. Both prior values were measured on the wrong domain (cyberlink.com.au, a Brisbane web-software firm unrelated to the Perth ISP); on the correct domain cltechnet.com the ISP was absorbed into Cyber Networks between Jun and Oct 2006.

refs.label: Australian ISP List shows the Perth ISP's real domain was cltechnet.com — brief's cyberlink.com.au is an unrelated Brisbane software/web firm ('Cyberlink Comput
Last full retail ISP homepage, 22 Jun 2006
Meta-refresh splash to Cyber Networks by 4 Oct 2006 — brand absorbed; later a PlanetDomain registrar stub

events.details: cyberlink.com.au captures 1996-2005 show CYBERlink Computing Services Pty Ltd running an "Australian Marketing Forum" (real estate/tourism/B&B directory), not the described Perth dialup/satellite ISP; the domain existed by Nov 1996. Attribution of this domain to the Perth ISP is unverified.
